description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic and Puppeteer Clique trigger.
Resolve the Hardened Academic trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Puppeteer Clique.
Resolve the Puppeteer Clique trigger, allowing you to put a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.
